title: DIANA Project Officially Launched
body: The DIANA project has officially started, funded by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR – FIS 3) with a total budget of €1,036,113.73. The project will develop an AI-powered digital twin platform for adaptive management of pediatric Type 1 Diabetes.

title: Sofia Campara Joins the Team
body: Thrilled to share that Sofia Campara will join DIANA as a PhD student starting November 1, 2026. Sofia will focus on the activities of Work Package 2 by refining and developing digital twins and AI-based decision support modules for pediatric type 1 diabetes leveraging CGM and wearable data.
